title: Serial dilution 200 µL → 2 × 100 µL into plate

containers.name: reservoir
containers.description: Reagent trough, pre-filled with source liquid

steps.source_quote: Move 200 microlitres from the reservoir into two wells on the plate.
steps.note: 100 µL per well (total 200 µL); wells A1/B1 assumed; single aspirate + two dispenses at robot layer

assumptions: per_well_volume=100 µL — total 200 µL split equally between two wells
wells=A1,B1 — first two rows of column 1
single_aspirate_for_both — aspirate 200 µL once, dispense 100 µL twice
plate is a standard 96-well plate (360 µL working capacity per well)
reservoir is pre-filled with ≥200 µL of reagent
